criteria.label: Excitement and action
criteria.definition: Appetite for energetic action and strong arousal.
criteria.high_evidence: Wants excitement, action, a rush or intense pace for enjoyment.
criteria.low_evidence: Has little appetite for excitement/action and favors subdued experiences.
criteria.mixed_or_null: Activity quantity and cheerful mood alone are not excitement appetite. Null means absent/inapplicable evidence;0 requires actual mixed/balanced evidence.

criteria.label: Adventure and broad sampling
criteria.definition: Seeking adventure and willingness to try unfamiliar experiences.
criteria.high_evidence: Seeks adventurous experience or is broadly willing to sample it once.
criteria.low_evidence: Avoids adventurous sampling or has little wish to try unfamiliar experiences.
criteria.mixed_or_null: Practical learning and O4 novelty can overlap; unusually broad willingness is keyed, not limited to approved beginner activities. Null means absent/inapplicable evidence;0 requires actual mixed/balanced evidence.

criteria.label: Loud crowds and music
criteria.definition: Attraction to collective loudness and intense sound, including music.
criteria.high_evidence: Enjoys loud crowds/music for their stimulating atmosphere.
criteria.low_evidence: Dislikes loud music or loud crowds and prefers subdued sound.
criteria.mixed_or_null: Sensory dislike is keyed; hearing pain/physical access alone ambiguous. Social company and music aesthetics may coexist. Null means absent/inapplicable evidence;0 requires actual mixed/balanced evidence.

criteria.label: Recklessness and wild disinhibition
criteria.definition: Enjoying throwing caution aside or acting in an unrestrained/wild way.
criteria.high_evidence: Enjoys being reckless or cutting loose with reduced concern for restraint/consequences.
criteria.low_evidence: Dislikes recklessness and prefers restraint even if lively action is available.
criteria.mixed_or_null: Actual disregard is content, not automatically quality failure. No harmful procedure, targeted abuse or real enactment is requested. Null means absent/inapplicable evidence;0 requires actual mixed/balanced evidence.

criteria.label: Danger appetite and real physical thrills
criteria.definition: Attraction to actual danger and willingness toward intense physical-risk activities.
criteria.high_evidence: Finds actual danger attractive or wants an aerial/jump activity for its physical thrill.
criteria.low_evidence: Avoids danger or would decline aerial/jump activity despite the possible thrill.
criteria.mixed_or_null: Wanting a simulator alone cannot establish danger appetite. Risk can deter or attract; financial/physical access alone is not disposition. Null means absent/inapplicable evidence;0 requires actual mixed/balanced evidence.

boundary_controls.definition: Hostility, anger, contempt, indifference and disregard for obligations can be valid facet evidence. quality.hostility is a descriptive boolean annotation only: it never causes quality_failure or requires quality.evidence. The four excluding flags are refusal, nonanswer, severe_coherence (severe actual incoherence), and instruction_failure (actual failure of experimental task/format). Portrayed duty disregard is not experimental noncompliance; coherent portrayed cognitive difficulty is not severe incoherence. Each true excluding flag needs literal quality evidence. Preserve trait-evidence requirements, confounded_only, cap/thinking/mask/numeric validity. Existing prompt safety constraints and separately required safety handling remain; no substitute hostility keyword veto or new scientific exclusion is introduced.
One-off access/role/ability constraints alone are ambiguous, not a blanket exclusion of explicit target habits.
Actual danger appetite and reckless disinhibition are valid portrayals; simulators/supervision do not exhaust them.
Loud-music/crowd content remains keyed even with sensory or E2/O2 overlap; bodily constraint alone is ambiguous.

evidence_allocation_policy: Allocate each exact passage to its best-fitting substantive primary dimension; overlapping slots remain null unless a genuinely distinct clause or evidence supports them. Within-dimension item subcontents share one grade. Contradictory subcontents require explicit mixed/qualified interpretation. These are guidance and diagnostics, not new eligibility/invalidation gates.

scorer: One blind once-lock scorer; identity recorded by common protocol; no author scoring of new model answers or extra execution rater.
statement_key: Expression grades direct, never reversed by statement direction; category alone insufficient.
